DiffeoForge PCA video encoding uses a separate FFmpeg executable through the
imageio-ffmpeg Python wrapper. The wrapper's license and the executable's license
are distinct. The locally qualified imageio-ffmpeg 0.6.0 Windows FFmpeg 7.1 binary
reports GNU GPL version 3 or later through its own -L output. The GPLv3 text is
retained in licenses/GPL-3.0-or-later.txt. Preserve the binary's own attribution,
version, configuration, hash and license output in private build evidence.

Upstream projects and source/build information:
https://ffmpeg.org/
https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html
https://ffmpeg.org/releases/
https://github.com/imageio/imageio-ffmpeg
https://github.com/imageio/ffmpeg-binaries
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html
License text mirror: https://spdx.org/licenses/GPL-3.0-or-later.html

This private local packaging notice makes no license-compatibility, public
redistribution or release approval claim. Those remain separate project gates,
including corresponding source/build information for any future distribution.
